## EasyGerber (Remote)

EasyGerber's official service provides AI PCB design, layout, and routing with published catalog parts. A typical workflow creates a schematic, generates a layout, inspects previews and checks, and exports board files. This guest-first entry allows discovery without an account; guest operations require a private session limited to one board. Account-board operations require separately configured EasyGerber OAuth and client support; account permissions, plan limits and billing apply. Placement, routing and scoring run on proprietary EasyGerber servers; the linked repository contains the public integration, and [setup, workflow and access documentation](https://www.easygerber.com/agents) describes the service.
